scope: Private bounded collection snapshots of typed recorded image-verification observations and explicitly granted ordinary-file retention under DE-W034. No new product command, stable persisted/public ABI, authenticated custody or current-image authority.
original: Construct from the typed AcquisitionCase and its actual raw request/history. Reconstruct the case from those raw bytes and require exact full-view/revision equality. Preserve the validated UTF-8 raw request and encode all raw history bytes as canonical lowercase even-length hexadecimal, including a torn suffix containing invalid UTF-8/NUL. Hash the original decoded bytes, not their hexadecimal text. Reject odd, uppercase, nonhex or oversized history encodings; never replace undecodable bytes. Input bounds and aggregate snapshot bounds are both mandatory. Never reopen any path retained inside them. Original acquisition claims remain unchanged. A collection has a canonical collection: identifier followed by 32 lowercase hex digits.
records: with_observation returns a new bounded snapshot; the previous collection and records remain unchanged. Each ordinal record binds the exact collection context, typed observation revision/full view, a separate observer descriptor, previous record digest and SHA-256 of the complete canonical record excluding its digest. Context binds collection ID, case revision and raw-request/history digests. Genesis previous digest is sha256: followed by 64 zeros. Reject an observation for a different original case, duplicate observation revision or duplicate capture epoch. An attempt reused across captures must retain the same worker/process binding; a worker epoch cannot denote different processes or verifier code identities. Sequence is a collection ordinal domain, not a worker/event sequence or a clock-derived order.
observer: Exactly attempt_id (attempt: plus 32 lowercase hex), worker_epoch (worker: plus 32 lowercase hex), capture_epoch (capture: plus 32 lowercase hex), process_id (positive canonical u32 decimal string), process_created (positive canonical u64 decimal string). These declarations bind records but do not authenticate the observer, prove fresh sampling, establish process exit or grant replacement/retry authority. Native qualification records the actual current probe PID/Windows creation time and separately generated epochs.
restore: Accept only the complete canonical private JSON UTF-8 plus one LF within the retention bound. Validate strict top-level/record/observer shapes, original raw-byte case reconstruction, context, contiguous ordinal sequence, every prior/record/observation digest, observer uniqueness/continuity and the full typed observation through its original constructor invariants. Compare rebuilt full view with the retained value; reject added claims/fields, contradictory computed clocks, unknown versions, truncated bytes and mismatched digests. Restore performs no OS calls and follows no retained path. A structurally consistent edited-and-rehashed record still does not authenticate origin.
support: Exactly the existing four-boolean policy. Project only ordinal records and each typed observation's selected support, plus fixed original-case claims/limits. identifiers adds collection ID and the record's observer descriptor; no original case/request/history/context/record/resource/observation digests or routing paths enter support under any policy. No hashes or pseudonyms substitute for omitted data. customer_data adds no fields here. SupportArtifact uses recorded-image-verification-collection-support; its digest covers only selected output bytes.
retention: CollectionRetentionArtifact accepts only a typed collection, encodes the complete private view plus one LF and labels it recorded-image-verification-collection-private with null policy. It includes private paths and raw metadata and is never a support artifact. The shared ExportArtifact is constructible only from typed SupportArtifact or CollectionRetentionArtifact, never arbitrary JSON/bytes. Its ordinary-file effect requires the exact immutable effect digest, report_write, host_effects and the additional private_metadata grant for private retention. Preparation creates no output. Preserve partial/uncertain outputs, use create-new, flush/readback checks and no automatic retry. API-confirmed flush is not power-loss persistence or authenticated custody.
native_review: The private qualification probe reviews a wrapper binding collection revision and the complete effect definition. Its grant uses that wrapper digest plus report_write, host_effects and private_metadata. An inner-only/wrong digest or any false required flag cannot create output. Current product acquisition-export validation must reject both new scopes. Historical snapshots need no current image/source access to be retained; selected paths inside a record confer no access authority.
file_reader: Read only an explicitly supplied ordinary-file path and expected artifact SHA-256. Hold pinned ancestors and an ordinary single-link non-reparse file with read sharing only, reject oversized files before allocation, read finite chunks, compare exact digest and restore through the pure validator. Validate held metadata/path/parents before and after reads; expose a separate current source binding and revalidation. It never opens original case/image/map/request paths retained inside the collection. Same bytes at a new file generation do not establish original resource continuity.
qualification: Define expectations before evaluation. Independently reconstruct context/record/full-view hashes and all sixteen exact support policies. Save and reload actual generated-file observations, including a torn acquisition suffix, and compare immutable snapshots. Exercise wrong/private-disabled grants, existing outputs, selected artifact mismatch, truncation, strict shape/chain/observer/clock/outcome contradictions, record and byte limits, and source changes while held. Keep actual effects separate from synthetic records and preserve dependencies until actual owned-process exit.
next_gate: Qualify bounded same-file image-verification reader/store/watch/cancellation and product frontend journeys before image.verify availability. Full DE-W034 before/after/custody, authenticated actors, all specified platforms/storage and owner/physical/elevation/customer/install/signing/publication gates remain separate.
